---
title: "**Modules**"
output:
  html_document
---

GEMs is a collection of short, experiential activities built for developing biology and computational skills. 

```{r load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

```{r make-data-frame, echo = FALSE}
contents <- tibble(module = character(),
                   length = character(),
                   topics = character(), 
                   description = character(),
                   classes = character()) 
# Add short modules
contents <- contents %>% 
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/AOU_ethics.html">"All of Us: Understanding Ethics"</a>'),
          length = "45 minutes",
          topics = "Ethics, Genomics",
          description = "This module uses the All of Us Data Browser to encourage critical thinking on ehtical concepts in human genomics",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/dna_forensics.html">"Forensic Case Files: DNA Barcoding"</a>'),
          length = "30 minutes",
          topics = "DNA Barcoding, Species Identification",
          description = "This activity explores forensic uses of DNA barcoding.",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/AI_genomics.html">"Gut Check: AI and Genomic Literature"</a>'),
          length = "45 minutes",
          topics = "AI, Ethics, Genomics",
          description = "This short activity focused on the critical approach scientists must use to evaluate the validity of information, including information provided by Large Language Model (LLM) chat sources.",
          classes = NA) # Fill in classes
# Add lab-period modules
contents <- contents %>% 
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/database_detectives.html">"Database Detectives: Exploring Public Genomic Databases"</a>'),
          length = "2 hours",
          topics = "Curated Databases, Homologs and Orthologs, Model Organisms, Gene Ontology, Genome Assembly", 
          description = "This activity guides students through using publicly-available genomics databases.",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/dna_barcoding.html">"DNA Barcoding: Forensic Investigators"</a>'),
          length = "1.5 hours",
          topics = "DNA Barcoding, Curated Databases, Species Identification", 
          description = "This activity explores forensic uses of DNA barcoding and DNA reference datasets.",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = "DNA Fingerprinting (coming soon!)", 
          length = NA,
          topics = NA, 
          description = NA,
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = "Escape Room: All of Us Research Bench (coming soon!)",
          length = NA,
          topics = NA, 
          description = NA,
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/epigenetics_explorer.html">"Epigenetics Explorer: Differentiating Cell Types"</a>'),
          length = "1 hour",
          topics = "Epigenetics", # Fill in additional topics 
          description = "This activity teaches students to use the UCSC Genome Browser to explore differences in epigenetic signals across cell types.",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/family_markers.html">"Family Markers: Using Multiply-Affected Families to Identify Risk Genes"</a>'),
          length = "1.5 hours",
          topics = "Hardy-Weinberg, Drift, Natural Slection", 
          description = "This activity teaches students to interpret pedigree information and use bioinformatics tools (R) to build pedigrees for tracking disease traits in families.",
          classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes
    add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/genomic_med_prs.html">"Genomic Medicine: Polygenic Risk Score Calculation"</a>'),
          length = "1.5 hours",
          topics = "PRS Calculation, Genetic Testing, Ancestry", 
          description = "This activity will walk through how to use an online polygenic risk score (PRS) calculator, as well as how to interpret the outcome.",
          classes = "Introductory Biology, Biology for Non-Majors") %>%
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/pop_gen_hwe.html">"Population Genetics: Fish Pond Simulator"</a>'),
          length = "1.5 hours",
          topics = "Bipolar Disorder, Genetics, Pedigree", 
          description = "This module uses the PopGen Fishbowl simulator to model natural selection and genetic drift, as well as explore whether populations are at Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.",
          classes = "Introductory Biology, Evolution") 
# Add research modules
contents <- contents %>%
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/mouse_gutbrain_de.html">"Differential Expression and the Mouse Gut-Brain Axis"</a>'),
          length = "1.5 hours",
          topics = "Differential Expression, Gut-brain Axis, Neurodevelopmental disorders, Neurodegenerative Disorders", 
          description = "This module introduces students to differential expression analyses using the R programming language.",
          classes = NA) # Fill in classes
# Add other modules
contents <- contents %>%
  add_row(module = paste0('<a href=\"https://genomicseducation.org/module/exam_phys.html">"Exam Physiology: Wearable Data and Stress"</a>'),
          length = "2 hours",
          topics = "Correlation, Physiological Data, Stress-monitoring Devices", 
          description = "This module introduces data analysis of physiology data.",
          classes = NA) # Fill in classes

# Order modules
contents <- contents %>%
  mutate(length_sort = case_when(
           str_detect(length, "minute") ~ readr::parse_number(length),
            str_detect(length, "hour") ~ 60 * readr::parse_number(length)),
         module_sort = str_extract(module, '(?<=">)[^<]+(?=</a>)') %>%
           str_remove_all('^"|"$') %>%
           coalesce(module) %>%
           tolower) %>%
  arrange(length_sort, module_sort) 

# Make DataTable
datatable(contents,
          rownames = FALSE,
          colnames = c("Module", "Estimated time", "Topics", "Description", "Classes suited for", "", ""),
          filter = "top", 
          options = list(paging = FALSE,
                         autoWidth = TRUE,
                         columnDefs = list(
                         list(orderData = 6, targets = 0), # Sort "module" by "module_sort"
                         list(orderData = 5, targets = 1), # Sort "length" by "length_sort" 
                         list(visible = FALSE, targets = c(5, 6)))), # Hide "length_sort" and "module_sort"
          escape = FALSE) %>%
  formatStyle(columns = names(contents), fontSize = "85%")
```
